description: Aménagement cyclables et circulation apaisée is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agglomération Montargoise Et rives du loing. Inventory of cycling and calming traffic sections of the territory. Coverage: Agglomération Montargoise Et rives du loing. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling and calming traffic" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agglomération Montargoise Et rives du loing. Its keywords include villemandeur, amilly, veloroute, chalette-sur-loing, saint-maurice-sur-fessard, paucourt. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2021-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
